message.content: Based on the conversation snippets, Wolfgang has a preference for a medium-rare patty, stating that he "get[s] the point of medium rare, but I think well-done is just safer and more flavorful." However, he also mentions enjoying a little char on his burger, suggesting a preference for a medium-rare patty but an openness to slight overcooking. This indicates that Wolfgang appreciates a juicy, slightly undercooked patty but is open to adjustments for safety and personal taste.
